summary: First-finish smoke tests for Puskarcik Family Tree. Backend endpoints (people, tree root/focus with auth-gated dates, register, login, /auth/me, changes create, admin approve/reject, admin-only guard) all pass. Frontend renders family tree with Ludwig+Aniela and children, SVG connectors visible, guest hover shows no date tooltip, clicking a child navigates to /tree/{id} and shows parents above, Root and Back buttons work, admin login reveals dates on hover and opens person detail modal on focus click, /admin panel accessible only to admin (guest redirected to /), logout clears auth. Contributor submission -> admin approve pipeline verified end-to-end (new person appears in /api/people).
passed: GET /api/people returns 17 people with only id/name/gender (no birth_date)
GET /api/tree/root/default returns Ludwig's ID (key is `person_id`)
GET /api/tree/{id} as guest omits birth_date/death_date; returns focus/parents/spouses/children/siblings/child_spouses (8 children, 1 spouse, 7 child_spouses)
GET /api/tree/{id} authed as admin includes birth_date/death_date on focus person
POST /api/auth/register creates contributor and returns token
POST /api/auth/login admin creds returns role=admin + token
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer returns authenticated=true, role=admin
POST /api/changes as contributor creates pending change (id + status:pending)
GET /api/admin/changes as admin lists the pending change
POST /api/admin/changes/{id}/approve applies add_person; new person visible in /api/people
POST /api/admin/changes/{id}/reject returns ok=true without adding person
GET /api/admin/changes as contributor returns 403 Admin only
Homepage renders family-tree with focus + 8-9 child nodes, spouse node, 5 SVG connector layers
Guest hover on person node shows NO tooltip/date content
Clicking child-node navigates to /tree/{id}, tree re-centers, 2 parent nodes appear above
tree-home-btn returns to '/' (Ludwig root)
Login flow via login-form works; admin-panel-btn and logout-btn appear post-login
Authed hover reveals Birth/Death/date content in tooltip
Clicking focus-node while authed opens person-detail-modal with modal-close-btn
/admin route as admin shows Pending/Approved/Rejected tabs (curator panel)
Logout clears session; guest visiting /admin is redirected to /
action_items: Minor: modal-back-btn is not rendered when opening the modal directly from a tree page (no prior modal history). If spec requires it to always be present, revisit; otherwise this is expected behavior.
Minor: harmless React a11y warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' in console (person detail modal). Non-blocking.
